balls.text: ends the innings on a high with another six, length, length, length from Nehra and that's picked up with ease over deep square leg
yorker length on middle, dug out into the off side for a single
full outside off, runs that down to third man for a single
Mumbai bring up their 200, short ball and it's a slower one, Rohit sees that early and dispatches that over the deep square leg boundary, 200 for the first time this IPL
the flow of boundaries doesn't abate, Rohit moves back to Nehra, that's in the slot outside off and he smashes that over extra cover
caught and bowled, short and Rayudu went for the pull, got a top edge and Nehra got under it to take it easily
mistimes this but keeps the strike for the final over, chips that towards long-off, gets to Warner on the bounce
Irfan is getting clobbered, length ball outside off and he lofts it high and clean over the long-off boundary, plays it from the crease, middled it  superbly
four more, full toss, makes a bit of room and chips it just over extra cover for a boundary
lovely strike, through the line, pitched up outside off and he smacks that over long-off for a maximum
slower full toss and though he doesn't middle it, he has enough on it to clear midwicket for a boundary
full outside off, digs it towards point for a single
bowled it full on the off, drives it to long-on for a single to keep strike
slower one bowled short on the off, taps it in front of extra cover and races through for a single
short outside off, chops that past point into the deep for a couple of runs
Pollard goes, tried to clear extra cover but couldn't get it past the fielder, bowled on a length and he would have succeeded dispatching that most times but finds the fielder here
shortish outside off, chops it down towards point for a boundary
bowled that full on the off, moves away and drives that through extra cover for a couple of runs
Rohit guides that wide of point for a single to bring up his half-century, played a good supporting role to Karthik, was under some pressure coming in to this match, this should give him some relief
almost yorker length, manages to dig that out wide of extra cover for a single
powerfully struck, that was bowled short on the off and Pollard just flat-batted that past the bowler, and past the diving long-off, for a boundary
bowled that full outside off, steered that one down to third man for a single
poor bowling, a full toss from Morkel, makes room and cracks him over mid-on for a boundary
slower one bowled short outside off, cut away towards third man for a single
crashes that on the up through the line towards long-off for a single
Pollard doesn't take too long to get moving, length ball, in the slot for the big man and he strikes it clean and long over long-on
down the leg side and that's been called a wide
bowled that full on middle, drives it just wide of long-off for a single
slower one bowled short, flat-bats it, lands just short of Warner at mid-on
appeal for lbw but that may have been sliding down, struck him high on the pads as well, tried to work that into the leg side
full toss on middle, gets on the back foot and whips it, gently but timed well, to the midwicket boundary
steals a quick single, pushes that one towards mid-off and runs through

Oh dear, Karthik has missed out on a ton and he's visibly upset, Morkel angled that in, Karthik moved across and then chipped it towards extra cover, sliced it slightly, a comfortable catch but that ends an excellent innings
full outside off, Rohit steers that one down to third man for a single
cheekily done, angling in towards middle, gets across and scoops it over short fine for a boundary
...to be struck for four, not struck, edged rather, Rohit made room to drive that through cover, thick outside edge to the third-man boundary
Karthik's racing towards the first ton of this IPL, short on the off and that's pulled with disdain through midwicket for another boundary
valiant effort in the deep, slower one from Irfan and that was pulled hard by Karthik, struck square and there was a deep square leg in place, dived full length to his right but couldn't get to it
full on leg stump, turns it away towards deep square leg for a single
calmly runs that one down towards third man for a single
slightly short outside off, tries to run it past the keeper, ends up gloving it towards him
slightly short on the off, punches it into the deep off the back foot for a single
tries to close the face on that one, doesn't make contact, is struck on the pads
Rohit reaches forward, then clips it towards short fine for a single
crashes that one on the bounce towards long-on for a single, Mendis gave it some air this time
point dives but can't stop that, short outside off, a bit of width and Karthik chops that away past that fielder for four
comes down the track and pushes it towards long-off for a single
Rohit's turn to cash in, brings up the century stand with a superb hit over extra cover, comes down the track, makes a bit of room simultaneously and crashes that over the ropes for six
no stopping Karthik, he has an excellent shot at a century here, short outside off and that's been cracked off the back foot through extra cover, deep extra cover dives but can't pull it back in
flattish on the off, makes room and drives that through point into the deep for a single
swept again, towards deep backward square leg for just the single this time
slog-sweep from Karthik and that clears the ropes, fired in towards middle and he sends that over the deep square leg boundary for a flat six
tries to open the face to that flat delivery outside off, doesn't make contact
angling in towards middle, gets on the back foot and pushes it into the leg side
Karthik keeps the boundaries coming, width and he opens the face, more a late-cut to beat short third man for four more
chipped in the vacant midwicket region for a single
the googly, short, gets on the back foot and pushes it towards extra coverr
flatter from Jeevan, Rohit comes down the track and defends it back to the bowler
tries to crash that into the off side, gets a thick inside edge for a single
floating it full on middle, turns that towards square leg for a single
rolls that into the leg side for one more
nudges that one into the leg side in front of square lg for a single
angling in towards off and middle, defended into the off side
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and punches it towards mid-off for a single
pulls that towards deep square leg for one more
Rohit knocks that into the leg side past midwicket for a single
slightly short on the off, mistimes an attempted punch back to the bowler
superbly done, full on middle and that's flicked away over square leg for a boundary, elegantly done

fullish on the off, pushes it towards mid-on for a single and gets another one on the overthrow after the fielder at mid-on scores a direct hit on the non-striker's end, 50 for Karthik, a valuable knock
that's four more, didn't strike it too well but managed to get enough on it to earn four more, drags it from the off stump, he kept that down and played it through midwicket again
down the leg side, tries to flick it fine, misses, called a wide
Karthik's dominating things here, short outside off and he pulls that with ease over midwicket for four more
slightly short outside off, gets on the back foot and plays that towards third man for a single
shortish on the off, punches it towards deep cover for one more
slightly short outside off, chops that one down towards point
shortish on middle, pulls that wide of deep midwicket of a single
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and punches it wide of long-on for a single
sweeps this towards short fine for a quick single
deft touches, shortish outside off, waits for it and guides it past short-third man for a boundary, Karthik is doing it well
Rohit hits a six, tries to swing that over square leg, gets a top edge and it sails over the third-man boundary, Mumbai have recovered well here
angling in towards middle, flicked away towards deep square leg for a single, well the umpire calls it a no-ball, Morkel has overstepped
gets on the front foot and defends it towards cover, no single on offer this time
goodish length, gets on the front foot and taps it in front of cover for a single
shortish on leg stump, tries to glance it fine, clips the pads and almost goes to the boundary, they pick up three more, leg-byes
gets front and across and flicks it through square leg for a single
Morkel angles that in towards leg stump, tries to turn it into the leg side, strikes him high on the pads
smartly done, Nehra dropped it short, he came down the track and just punched it over midwicket, not much force in that shot, just a chip and it fetches him four more
gets across to turn it through square leg into the deep for a single
short on the off, drags it wide of mid-on for a single
aggression from Karthik, comes down the track, that's short on leg and he whips that away to the fine-leg boundary again
ooh, banged in short and Karthik goes after that one, got a top edge and it cleared the fine-leg boundary
nicely struck but straight to point, short of a length and Karthik cut it straight to Warner
back of a length on the off, rocks back and drops it towards cover
short of a length outside off, leaves it alone, ooh, called a wide, seemed harsh
Well, Rohit is getting bogged down and he wants to open up, charges down the track and tries to launch him over mid-off, similar delivery to the previous one, goes past the outside edge
beaten, on a length and Rohit tries to drive that in the direction of mid-off, that moves away to go past the outside edge, lovely delivery
fullish outside off, gets forward and opens the face to guide it towards point
on Rohit's pads, full delivery on leg stump and that's flicked straight to square leg
shortish on the off, knocks that down into the off side and steals a quick single
comes down the track and flicks it towards short fine, Morkel fumbles and concedes a single
shortish on middle, he tries to pull it over square leg, is struck on the thigh, they get another leg-bye
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and guides it to point
shortish outside off, runs that one down to third man for a single
shortish on leg stump, pushed through square leg for a well-run couple
clips the pads as he gets across to play it into the leg side, gets a leg-bye

Irfan is a good fielder but he overruns the ball this time, thick outside edge as he tries to drive it through cover, Irfan at third man didn't read the turn in the deep as the ball spun past him to roll over the ropes
lovely ball, got this to move away, pushed it full outside off and Karthik tried to defend it with an open face, it moved away to beat the outside edge
appeal for lbw, there may have been an inside edge there, Morkel pushed him back, struck him in line, replays suggest no inside edge but height was an issue, would have probably gone over
beaten, this one was bowled on a good length outside off, moved in and beat him through the gate as he tried to drive that on the up
struck high on the pads, nips that in, tried to turn that square, couldn't do so
Karthik is looking good, welcomes Morkel with a boundary, lovely shot, gets to the pitch and drives that stylishly between extra cover and mid-off
slightly short outside off, knocks it down into the off side for a single to keep strike
nicely played, shortish outside off and he crunches it off the back foot between point and cover to liven up this crowd that had gone silent for a bit
shortish outside off and he leaves that alone to the keeper

Tendulkar is run out, Pitched up and that was driven to mid-off, Tendulkar wanted the single, Karthik sent him back, Jayawardene moved to his left, picked up and aimed accurately at the non-striker's end, Tendulkar knows he is gone, doesn't wait for the third umpire's decision, out by a long way
beaten, short of a good length outside off, appeared to nip away, tried to run that down to third man, missed
uppishly played, pitched on a good length and he drives it back towards the bowler, may have just  fallen short, he fumbles and allows them a single
Ponting goes, five dot balls and that's done the job, Ponting came down the track and tried to loft him over mid-off, struck it straight to the fielder, goes for a duck

ooh, nicely bowled, got it to swing in towards middle, Ponting moved across and was looking to flick it square, got a leading edge in the direction of point and Warner did well, diving to his left to save the single
walks across does Ponting and works that shortish delivery away to midwicket
rocks forward to push it towards the off side, gets a thick inside edge in the direction of midwicket
draws him forward with a good length delivery, gets to the pitch and pushes it towards extra cover
slightly short on off and middle, appeared to swing in, gets on the back foot and defends it in front of the bowler
a similar end to each innings today, that's been dispatched for six over deep square leg, but Delhi have lost three in three
struck to long-on for a single
tries to send that back to Delhi, slower one bowled from well behind the stumps, misses
swung away over square leg for a boundary, Umesh chipping in
banged in short outside leg stump and Umesh lets that go past him
bowls it from behind the stumps, short and it's been pulled well but straight to Ojha at deep midwicket
in the blockhole outside off, digs it out into the leg side for a single
bowled it on a length outside off, tries to get his bat to it, misses
short outside off, slaps that hard towards deep cover for a single
that one has been thwacked down the ground, pitched on a length and it's been struck clean past the bowler
four more, fullish and he drives that past a diving Ponting at midwicket, late surge from Delhi but it's not going to enough
a boundary, short and wide and he goes hard at that one, gets a thick outside edge to the third-man boundary
full outside off, Nehra fails to get his bat to that one
slow full toss on middle, makes room and plays it to midwicket

run-out, Mumbai have been brilliant in the field today, pushes it to midwicket, wants the single, is sent back and Rishi Dhawan scores a direct hit at the striker's end, Juneja goes for 49, a well-played knock but there was too much to get, Mumbai are easing to victory here
slower one bowled short, swings it towards deep square leg for a single
dropped it short, Juneja pulls it to deep square leg for a single
fullish on the off, drives it towards mid-on for a quick single,  Pollard scores a direct hit but Morkel is well in
Morkel swings at that one, gets it down to long-on for a single
floating it on the off stump, plays it in front of point for a quick single, appeal for a run-out, Morkel makes it comfortably
gets on the back foot and turns it through square leg for a single
slowed it up considerably did Ojha, took a while to get to the batsman, tried to clear extra cover there but played it too early, an easy catch offered to point
gets forward and tickles it into the leg side for a single
angling in towards middle, makes room and plays it towards point
easy pickings, down the leg side and Manprit clips that down to the fine-leg boundary, too late however
the slower offcutter, gets on the back foot and guides it to Karthik
yorker length on the off stump, dug out into the off side, can't do much about those
slower one from Malinga, a low full toss, defended into the off side for a single
he's gone now, quite a few caught-and bowleds today, slower one and Jadhav struck it straight back to Malinga, he fumbled on the first attempt but retained his composure to take it on the second
shortish on middle from Malinga, jabs that into the leg side for a single
floating it full on middle, tries to paddle it fine, Ojha appeals for an lbw but the umpire reckons there was some contact with the bat there, a single to Juneja
flicked away into the deep past square leg for a couple of runs
tries to work it square off the back foot, struck high on the pads
makes room and finds the boundary after slicing it over point, Manprit has played well today but there's only so much he can manage
floating it on middle, clipped into the leg side towards square leg for a single
that  should shut out Delhi, you would think, slog-swept, he had no choice, straight to deep midwicket, seemed like he connected well but not well enough in the end
Pathan goes over the top but ends up playing it on the bounce to long-on for a single
taps it into the off side just wide of the keeper
shortish outside off, chops that one down towards point
short ball on middle, pulls it towards deep square leg for a single
slightly short, punched through midwicket for a single into the deep
angling in on middle turned through square leg for a well-run couple
a leading edge as Pathan tries to turn it square, lands safely in the off side, they get a single
slightly short on the off, knocks it towards short third for a single
tries to work it into the on side, struck high on the pads
down the leg side and Manprit knocks that on its head to help it to the fine-leg boundary, or did it make any contact at all? No, it didn't, called wides
drives that one towards long-on for a single
Irfan takes that from the off stump and drives it through midwicket for a couple of runs
bowls that flat on leg stump, comes down the track to turn it into the leg side, gets a leg-bye
punched down the ground towards long-on for a single
that one is bowled down the leg side, called a wide
on a length outside off, pushed through the line to long-off for a single to bring up the century for Delhi
slight short on middle, gets on the back foot and knocks it in front of midwicket
pushes it into the off side, gets a single
turns it into the leg side

a soft dismissal, first ball, fullish and he hits it straight back to the bowler, Pollard calmly accepts it, no fuss, he's got his man in his pocket, he signals, by pretending to put the ball in his pocket
bowled that full outside off and Juneja tried to guide that towards third man, missed
angling in towards middle, that's been flicked through square leg for a couple of runs

didn't pick the slower one this time, Warner had made up his mind, made room and appeared to be into the shot too early, ended up chipping it over point into the off side, Rayudu ran in from the deep and took it well, big wicket, a decisive one possibly
Warner has hit that into the second tier behind fine leg, short outside leg stump and he helps it on its way, gave it his all did Warner there, Mumbai will be a tad worried now
four more, slower one and Warner picked it, waited for it and drilled it past Harbhajan at mid-off
Johnson bowls that on a good length outside off, chipped towards long-off for a single
That extra ball has cost Mumbai, short outside off and that's been cut away past point for a boundary, Warner brings up his fifty but there's much to be done
reaches for that one, wide called this time, Warner tried to crack that through point and missed
offcutter bowled short outside off, cut straight to Harbhajan at point, just the single
has to reach for that one to cut it towards deep point for a single
Pollard's just got the treatment he's meted out to many a bowler, length ball on the off and Warner launches him a fair distance over long-on
almost yorker length on middle, digs that one out wide of midwicket for a single
slower one bowled on a length, driven down to long-on for a single
shortish on middle, turned past midwicket for one more
punched off the back foot into the leg side for a single
nicely done by Manpreet, there was a bit of width on that one and he reverse-paddled that to the third-man boundary, beating short third to the ropes, the fielder gave chase and dived in vain
slightly short outside off, cuts it past point for a single
gets on the back foot and turns it into the leg side for a single

tossed up outside off and he tries to force that through extra cover, misses, Karthik takes off the bails but his feet left the ground momentarily, seemed to be just in at the time that the bails were taken off, appeal for a stumping but that appeared to have come down in time, the third umpire is taking a while on this and the image is blurry at the time of impact, the benefit of the doubt goes to the batsman
Warner lets that one go thinking that'll be a wide, it's not called, slower one bowled outside off
shortish outside off, runs it down towards third man for a single
this, too, was bowled from behind the crease, slower one bowled short on the off, mistimes a cut to cover
fullish on the off, pushed towards long-on for a single
slightly short, jabs it through square leg for a single
slightly short on the off, rocks on the back foot and pushes it towards cover
full on the off, turns it through to deep midwicket for a single
flatter this time, comes down the track and pushes it back towards the bowler
Warner smashes that miles behind the deep midwicket boundary, long hop from Ojha and it's been punished
Manpreet slog-sweeps, playing that to the right of deep midwicket, can't quite get it past Rayudu, brings up the Delhi fifty with a single
gets on the back foot and turns it through square leg for a single
Warner gets on the back foot and gently turns it into the leg side past midwicket, scampers back for the second
full toss on middle, drives it towards mid-off for a quick single, a quiet over, Mumbai have had the better of the Powerplay
slower offcutter, Manpreet tried to run that past Karthik but missed, Karthik fumbled behind the stumps, conceding a bye
a thick outside edge as he made room to drive that through off, a single down to third man for Warner
low full toss on the off, mistimed an attempted drive towards mid-off
slightly short outside off, runs that one down towards third man for a single
slower one bowled full outside off, pushed it straight to extra cover
short, it's a packed field on the off side, makes room but cuts it straight to the fielder at point
makes a bit of room and Johnson chases him, turns it away wide of Tendulkar at mid-on for a couple of runs
full toss on the pads and Warner doesn't waste it, flicks it away through square leg for a boundary
shortish on the off, was on the body, tapped that one wide of slip towards third man for a single
slides that one on the pads and Manpreet clips that down to the fine-leg boundary
that's an excellent shot, Manpreet got back in the crease and drilled it past the bowler, wide of mid-off, for four more
Warner goes over long-on and sends that one into the stands, came down the track to that flighted delivery and gave it a big thump
slightly short on the off, knocks it down from the crease towards cover
flicked away through midwicket into the deep for a single
goes inside-out to that one and drives it wide of long-off, just the single
flatter outside off, gets across and turns it into the leg side for a single
tossed up on the off, long-off has been pushed back, driven to him for a single
slightly short on the off, knocks it down in front of slip from the crease
lovely drive, pushed through the line, bowled on a good length on middle and he drives it past the bowler, Harbhajan gives chase and tries to kick it back in but it touches the ropes
Delhi in trouble, the pressure of  big chase gets to Mahela, pushed it wide, Jayawardene comes down the track to smack that over extra cover, gets a thin edge through to the keeper
slides that one down the leg side, that's been called a wide
shortish outside off, cut down towards third man, Ojha has to run a little to his right to cut that off, two more
slightly short on the off, gets on the back foot and punches it towards extra cover
goodish length on the off, rocks forward and guides it towards point
uppishly played, shortish on leg stump and he flicked it past square leg for a boundary
pushed it into the leg side to play ti towards midwicket
Warner manages to squeeze that one through point, full outside off and that's sliced for a boundary
slower one on leg and middle, pushes it towards extra cover
that one swung in towards middle, digs that one out towards point from the crease
low full toss outside off, tries to drive but misses
gets on the back foot, pushed through quicker by Harbhajan, a single into the leg side
rocks forward and he pushes it back towards the bowler
turns it into the leg side towards square leg

dropped, Malinga spills that one, Jayawardene went for the sweep, got a top edge and Malinga at short fine ran back, a tough chance, he seemed to be in a good position to take that but couldn't hold on
beaten, the doosra and it turns away to just go past the outside edge

Oh dear, Delhi have lost Chand first ball, again! Ponting, you beauty, Chand reached forward to that one, closed the face on that to turn it into the leg side, got a leading edge and Ponting was brilliant at extra cover. It's the Ponting of old. He actually slipped, regained his balance and flung himself to his right to snap that with one hand. He flew there, just as Jonty had done in the 1992 World Cup, and they're both in the same team here
